site.name: Natural Healthy Village Kaengkrachan
site.description: Exclusive residential land community near Kaengkrachan National Park. Private lake, chapel island, 360° mountain views, self-sustainable infrastructure. 6 plots remaining from 16 total.

topics.title: Land Pricing and Available Plots at Natural Healthy Village
topics.title_th: ราคาที่ดินและแปลงที่มีจำหน่าย
topics.summary: Six residential plots remain from 16 total at Natural Healthy Village Kaengkrachan, priced from 2,500,000 to 7,000,000 THB (1,070–2,824 m²). Chanote deeds, 12+ rai common land, underground utilities. Updated July 2026.
questions: How much does land cost at Natural Healthy Village Kaengkrachan?
What plot sizes are for sale?
What is the lowest priced plot?

sections.heading: Plots currently available
sections.body: As of July 2026, six plots remain from sixteen total: Plot 1 (1,396 m², 3,500,000 THB), Plot 2a (1,070 m², 2,500,000 THB), Plot 3 (2,056 m², 5,000,000 THB), Plot 6 (2,824 m², 7,000,000 THB), Plot 9 (2,324 m², 6,500,000 THB), Plot 16 (2,164 m², 5,400,000 THB).

sections.heading: Plot sizes
sections.body: Plots were designed between 1,000 and 2,800 m² — enough for a large house, swimming pool, tropical garden, and space to grow vegetables and fruit.

sections.heading: What affects price
sections.body: Plot price reflects size (1,070–2,824 m²), position, and views. All plots include access to more than 12 rai of common green space, the private lake, walkways, and shared infrastructure. Residential use only. Every plot has underground 3-phase electrical supply with individual meter and three water supply lines with individual meters.

sections.heading: What makes NHVK different
sections.body: NHVK was designed for self-sustainability, low density, and living comfort. Many traditional developments offer only ~800 m² per plot and minimum common area (~5% as required by law). At NHVK, owners share more than 12 rai of lakes, walkways, and green space.

sections.heading: Title and tenure
sections.body: All plots hold Chanote title deeds (the highest land security in Thailand). Thai nationals may purchase freehold. Foreign nationals may register a 30-year renewable lease.

faqs.question: What is the lowest priced plot?
faqs.answer: Plot 2a is the entry plot at 2,500,000 THB for 1,070 m² (2 ngan 70 wah).

faqs.question: What plot sizes are available?
faqs.answer: Available plots range from 1,070 m² (Plot 2a) to 2,824 m² (Plot 6) — sized for a substantial home, pool, garden, and food growing.

faqs.question: Are prices negotiable?
faqs.answer: Contact the project team for current availability and to arrange a site visit. Phone 081 860 4501 (English/French) or 095 365 2500 (Thai).

topics.title: Buying Land as a Foreigner — 30-Year Lease at NHVK
topics.title_th: ชาวต่างชาติซื้อที่ดิน — สัญญาเช่า 30 ปี
topics.summary: Foreign nationals cannot own land freehold in Thailand but may hold a registered 30-year renewable lease at Natural Healthy Village with Chanote-backed plots.
questions: Can foreigners buy land at Natural Healthy Village?
What is a 30-year lease in Thailand?
Is the lease registered on the Chanote title?

sections.heading: Freehold vs lease
sections.body: Thai law restricts foreign freehold land ownership. At Natural Healthy Village, Thai buyers may purchase with full Chanote ownership. Foreign buyers typically use a 30-year registered lease, which is a legally recognised long-term tenure commonly used for residential land in Thailand.

sections.heading: Why Chanote matters
sections.body: Every plot at NHVK holds a Chanote title deed — the most secure form of land title in Thailand. A registered lease on Chanote land provides clarity for long-term residential use and inheritance planning. Always consult a Thai property lawyer for your personal situation.

sections.heading: Who to contact
sections.body: For English and French enquiries: Philippe Bremard, 081 860 4501, kaengkrachan.village@proton.me. Full brochure available on request. Site visits welcome.

faqs.question: Can the 30-year lease be renewed?
faqs.answer: Leases are commonly structured with renewal options; specific terms are set in the sale/lease agreement and should be reviewed with legal counsel.

faqs.question: Is this a resort or hotel project?
faqs.answer: No. Natural Healthy Village is residential land only — a private community for weekend homes or permanent residence, not commercial tourism.

topics.title: Self-Sustainable Solar, Water and Utilities at NHVK
topics.title_th: พลังงานและน้ำพึ่งพาตนเอง
topics.summary: Natural Healthy Village is designed for energy and water autonomy: solar panels in progress, private deep well, 3-phase PEA electricity, three water lines per plot, and all cables buried underground.
questions: Does Natural Healthy Village have solar power?
What water supply does each plot have?

sections.heading: Electricity
sections.body: 3-phase electricity from PEA (Provincial Electricity Authority) with an individual meter per plot. Solar panel installation is in progress toward full energy autonomy. All electrical cables are buried underground — no poles or overhead wires obstructing mountain views.

sections.heading: Water
sections.body: Each plot has three water supply lines with individual meters. The project includes a private deep well, water storage tank, and pump. Connection to public water supply is also available.

sections.heading: Design philosophy
sections.body: Self-sustainability supports weekend and permanent residents who want independence from city utilities while remaining ~2.5 hours from Bangkok. Infrastructure is built for long-term residential use, not short-term tourism.

faqs.question: Is solar fully operational?
faqs.answer: Solar panels are being installed; the project is working toward full energy autonomy. Contact the team for current status on your visit.

faqs.question: Can I grow food on my plot?
faqs.answer: Yes. Plots range from 1,070 to 2,824 m² — enough for fruit trees, vegetables, and private gardens.

topics.title: Sufficiency Economy Learning Center (Baan Din) near Kaengkrachan
topics.title_th: ศูนย์การเรียนรู้เศรษฐกิจพอเพียง บ้านดิน
topics.summary: Baan Din is an open farm-style sufficiency economy learning center near Khao Kling mountain, close to Natural Healthy Village. Visitors learn earth-block building, agriculture, and self-sufficiency. Established 2007, supported by HRH Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn.
questions: What is Baan Din Sufficiency Economy Learning Center?
Where is the sufficiency economy learning center near Kaengkrachan?
Is Baan Din safe to visit with family?

sections.heading: About Baan Din
sections.body: Rehabilitation and learning center for inmates with good conduct in open farm style. Participants learn earth-block houses, agriculture, and food production following King Rama IX Sufficiency Economy philosophy. Built 2007.

sections.heading: Location
sections.body: 87 Moo 8 Wangkrai Road, Kaengkrachan. Near turnaround from Phetkasem Road to Kaengkrachan Lake, close to Khao Kling mountain. Natural Healthy Village is behind Khao Kling mountain. Phone 032-465-171.

sections.heading: Connection to NHVK
sections.body: Earth-block techniques from Baan Din informed NHVK. The founding professor advised on early land development at Natural Healthy Village. Plot owners may request help building earth-block houses through the center.

faqs.question: Who supports Baan Din?
faqs.answer: HRH Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn. Established 2007 following King Rama IX directives.

faqs.question: Is it safe for families?
faqs.answer: Yes. Families and children welcome. Participants are friendly and explain activities. Feed animals, sheep farm attraction.

topics.title: Earth Block Construction at Natural Healthy Village
topics.title_th: การก่อสร้างกำแพงดิน
topics.summary: NHVK produces earth blocks from on-site soil and white limestone using a custom hydraulic press. Walls up to 60 cm thick provide natural cooling without air conditioning. Concrete structure with earth block infill.
questions: What are the advantages of earth block walls?
Is earth block construction expensive at NHVK?

sections.heading: How blocks are made
sections.body: Site earth mixed with white limestone and water in a plaster mixer, poured into moulds, hydraulically pressed, air-cured several days. Foundation excavation soil is reused. Techniques from Baan Din, refined at NHVK.

sections.heading: Advantages
sections.body: Thermal inertia keeps houses cool without AC. Limestone plaster helps walls breathe and release humidity. Earth is a living material in harmony with natural soil.

sections.heading: Structure and cost
sections.body: Concrete columns, beams, slabs; earth blocks for wall infill up to 60 cm. Single storey cheaper than Qcon. Two storeys need +20% structure cost. Slower build, trained workforce required.

sections.heading: Measured on site
sections.body: Entrance building: 60 cm wall room is 2°C cooler than 30 cm room year-round. 30 cm sufficient; 60 cm is luxury.

faqs.question: Is earth block solid?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ancient earth walls lasted centuries. NHVK uses concrete shell with earth block infill up to 60 cm thick.

faqs.question: Can plot owners build earth-block houses?
faqs.answer: Yes. Help and manpower available from Baan Din learning center. Contact NHVK team.

faqs.question: How is NHVK different from La Terre contractor?
faqs.answer: NHVK uses custom press and moulds with site soil-limestone mix. La Terre uses large formwork and heavy equipment at higher cost.
